ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet) CHM-delivered execution: hh.exe spawning script engines for AppleSeed/BabyShark stager
ucs.description: Hunts the Kimsuky-signature initial-access chain where a spearphishing-attached Compiled HTML Help (.chm) file is opened, causing the legitimate Windows HTML Help viewer (hh.exe) to spawn PowerShell/mshta/cmd/wscript that then pulls the AppleSeed or BabyShark second stage. CISA AA20-301A, KISA, AhnLab and Mandiant all document hh.exe → script-engine as the dominant 2022-2025 Kimsuky delivery chain against NK-policy researchers, journalists and think tanks.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="hh.exe" Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process, "(?i)(downloadstring|invoke-expression|iex |frombase64|webclient|bitstransfer|hidden|-enc |-encodedcommand|http://|https://|\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|certutil|mshta|regsvr32 /s|/i:http)")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky CHM (.chm) -> hh.exe -> script-engine chain (AppleSeed/BabyShark)
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "hh.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                              // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
      "DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX","FromBase64","WebClient","BitsTransfer",
      "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden",
      "http://","https://","\\AppData\\","\\Temp\\","\\Public\\",
      "certutil","/i:http","regsvr32 /s")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has ".chm"
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)::DataSpace|mk:@MSITStore"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky CHM -> hh.exe -> script-engine on Sentinel (SecurityEvent 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentLeaf == "hh.exe"
| where ChildLeaf in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","hh.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where CommandLine has_any (
      "DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX","FromBase64","WebClient","BitsTransfer",
      "-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-w hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden",
      "http://","https://","\\AppData\\","\\Temp\\","\\Public\\",
      "certutil","/i:http","regsvr32 /s",".chm")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky CHM Execution Chain - hh.exe Spawning Script Engines
id: 7f3c2d54-9b0e-4f88-9d2e-1c1ad9e4b801
status: experimental
description: Detects Kimsuky (APT43/Emerald Sleet) initial-access via .chm spearphishing where hh.exe spawns powershell/mshta/cmd/wscript with stager-typical command lines (CISA AA20-301A, AhnLab).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa20-301a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/06
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.001
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0094
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\hh.exe'
  child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  stager_markers:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX '
      - 'FromBase64'
      - 'WebClient'
      - 'BitsTransfer'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '/i:http'
      - 'regsvr32 /s'
  condition: parent and child_image and stager_markers
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate internal helpdesk CHM files that invoke scripts (rare; baseline 30 days)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@ParentImage:(*\hh.exe OR *\HH.exe OR *\HH.EXE) OR @ParentProcessName:(*\hh.exe OR *\HH.exe OR *\HH.EXE)) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe) (@CommandLine:(*DownloadString* OR *downloadstring* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *invoke-expression* OR *IEX* OR *iex* OR *FromBase64* OR *frombase64* OR *WebClient* OR *webclient* OR *BitsTransfer* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-encodedcommand* OR *"-enc "* OR *http\://* OR *https\://* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *.chm*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^hh\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|bitsadmin|certutil|curl|hh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(downloadstring|invoke-expression|iex |frombase64|webclient|bitstransfer|-encodedcommand|-enc |windowstyle hidden|-w hidden|http://|https://|\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|/i:http|regsvr32 /s|\\.chm)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), count(as=Hits)])
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: hh.exe (the Windows HTML Help binary) spawning script interpreters is itself rare; pairing it with stager-typical command line tokens (DownloadString, EncodedCommand, hidden window, AppData/Temp paths) is the documented Kimsuky CHM delivery chain for AppleSeed and BabyShark. Other actors occasionally use CHM (e.g. APT41) but the combination of CHM lure + hh.exe parent + immediate PowerShell/mshta

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / TA427) mailbox exfil: Exchange/M365 auto-forwarding rule to external address on policy-research target
ucs.description: Hunts the Kimsuky-signature post-compromise mail-exfil technique: after credential-phishing a NK-policy researcher, journalist, defector or think-tank account, the actor logs in and creates a hidden New-InboxRule / Set-Mailbox ForwardingSmtpAddress to silently forward all inbound mail to attacker-controlled webmail (Naver, Daum, Yandex, ProtonMail, Gmail). CISA AA23-263A and Mandiant APT43 profile call this out as Kimsuky's primary persistence-and-collection pattern.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Changes.command) as command values(All_Changes.src) as src_ip values(All_Changes.object) as rule_object values(All_Changes.object_attrs) as attrs from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action=created All_Changes.object_category IN ("InboxRule","Mailbox","transport_rule") (All_Changes.command IN ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox","Enable-InboxRule") OR All_Changes.object_attrs="*ForwardingSmtpAddress*" OR All_Changes.object_attrs="*ForwardTo*" OR All_Changes.object_attrs="*RedirectTo*" OR All_Changes.object_attrs="*DeliverToMailboxAndForward*") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.user_id All_Changes.src All_Changes.command All_Changes.object
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
| eval external_forward=if(match(attrs, "(?i)@(?!yourcorp\.com|yourcorp\.onmicrosoft\.com)\S+\.\w{2,}"), 1, 0)
| eval suspicious_dest=if(match(attrs, "(?i)@(naver|daum|hanmail|nate|kakao|yandex|protonmail|proton\.me|mail\.ru|gmx|tutanota|outlook\.kr|gmail)\."), 1, 0)
| where external_forward=1 OR suspicious_dest=1 OR match(command, "(?i)ForwardingSmtpAddress|DeliverToMailboxAndForward")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky mailbox auto-forwarding-rule creation (T1114.003 + T1564.008)
let KoreaPolicyKeywords = dynamic(["korea","dprk","nk","unification","defector","\uD1B5\uC77C","\uBD81\uD55C","think tank","sejong","asan","38north","journal","policy","researcher","analyst"]);
let SuspiciousFwdDomains = dynamic(["naver.com","daum.net","hanmail.net","nate.com","kakao.com","yandex.ru","yandex.com","protonmail.com","proton.me","mail.ru","gmx.com","tutanota.com","outlook.kr"]);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where Application has_any ("Microsoft Exchange Online","Office 365","Exchange")
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox","Enable-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules")
| extend Raw = tostring(RawEventData)
| where Raw has_any ("ForwardTo","RedirectTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo","ForwardingSmtpAddress","DeliverToMailboxAndForward")
| extend FwdTarget = extract(@"(?i)(?:ForwardTo|RedirectTo|ForwardingSmtpAddress|ForwardAsAttachmentTo)\"?\s*[:=]\s*\[?\"?([^\"\],}]+)", 1, Raw)
| extend FwdDomain = tolower(extract(@"@([^\"\s,>;\]\}]+)", 1, FwdTarget))
| extend IsExternalFwd = isnotempty(FwdDomain) and FwdDomain !endswith "yourcorp.com" and FwdDomain !endswith "yourcorp.onmicrosoft.com"
| extend IsHighRiskFwdDomain = FwdDomain in~ (SuspiciousFwdDomains)
| where IsExternalFwd or IsHighRiskFwdDomain
| join kind=leftouter (IdentityInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Department, JobTitle, EmailAddress) by AccountObjectId) on AccountObjectId
| extend TargetIsPolicy = JobTitle has_any (KoreaPolicyKeywords) or Department has_any (KoreaPolicyKeywords)
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, AccountUpn = AccountId, IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP, UserAgent,
          ActionType, FwdTarget, FwdDomain, IsHighRiskFwdDomain, TargetIsPolicy,
          Department, JobTitle, RawEventData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky inbox-rule / mailbox forwarding setup (OfficeActivity)
let SuspiciousFwdDomains = dynamic(["naver.com","daum.net","hanmail.net","nate.com","kakao.com","yandex.ru","yandex.com","protonmail.com","proton.me","mail.ru","gmx.com","tutanota.com","outlook.kr"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where OfficeWorkload in ("Exchange","AzureActiveDirectory")
| where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox","Enable-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules")
| extend ParamBlob = tostring(Parameters)
| where ParamBlob has_any ("ForwardTo","RedirectTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo","ForwardingSmtpAddress","DeliverToMailboxAndForward")
| extend FwdTarget = extract(@"(?i)(?:ForwardTo|RedirectTo|ForwardingSmtpAddress|ForwardAsAttachmentTo)[^\w]*?Value\"?\s*:\s*\"?([^\"]+)", 1, ParamBlob)
| extend FwdDomain = tolower(extract(@"@([^\"\s,>;\]\}]+)", 1, FwdTarget))
| extend IsExternalFwd = isnotempty(FwdDomain) and FwdDomain !endswith "yourcorp.com" and FwdDomain !endswith "yourcorp.onmicrosoft.com"
| extend IsHighRiskFwdDomain = FwdDomain in~ (SuspiciousFwdDomains)
| where IsExternalFwd or IsHighRiskFwdDomain
| join kind=leftouter (
    SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IPAddress, tostring(LocationDetails), UserAgent, AppDisplayName) by UserPrincipalName
  ) on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, FwdTarget, FwdDomain, IsHighRiskFwdDomain,
          SignInIP = IPAddress, LocationDetails, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, ParamBlob
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Suspicious External Mail Forwarding Rule Created (Kimsuky / APT43 / TA427)
id: 2b4a87f1-d31c-4f0d-bb12-3f9c0c4f7a02
status: experimental
description: Detects creation/modification of an Exchange/M365 inbox rule or mailbox forwarding setting that sends mail to a known Kimsuky-favoured webmail provider (Naver, Daum, Hanmail, ProtonMail, Yandex, Mail.ru, GMX). CISA AA23-263A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-263a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1114/003/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/06
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1114.003
  - attack.t1564.008
  - attack.g0094
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: exchange
detection:
  rule_op:
    Operation:
      - 'New-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-Mailbox'
      - 'Enable-InboxRule'
      - 'UpdateInboxRules'
  fwd_param:
    Parameters|contains:
      - 'ForwardTo'
      - 'RedirectTo'
      - 'ForwardAsAttachmentTo'
      - 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
      - 'DeliverToMailboxAndForward'
  high_risk_dest:
    Parameters|contains:
      - '@naver.com'
      - '@daum.net'
      - '@hanmail.net'
      - '@nate.com'
      - '@kakao.com'
      - '@yandex.ru'
      - '@yandex.com'
      - '@protonmail.com'
      - '@proton.me'
      - '@mail.ru'
      - '@gmx.com'
      - '@tutanota.com'
      - '@outlook.kr'
  condition: rule_op and fwd_param and high_risk_dest
falsepositives:
  - Korean-corporate personal forwarding (validate against HR records)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(office365 OR o365 OR azure.activeDirectory) (@Operation:(New-InboxRule OR Set-InboxRule OR Set-Mailbox OR Enable-InboxRule OR UpdateInboxRules) OR @evt.name:(New-InboxRule OR Set-InboxRule OR Set-Mailbox)) (@Parameters:(*ForwardTo* OR *RedirectTo* OR *ForwardingSmtpAddress* OR *ForwardAsAttachmentTo* OR *DeliverToMailboxAndForward*) OR @ModifiedProperties:(*ForwardingSmtpAddress* OR *ForwardTo*)) (@Parameters:(*@naver.com* OR *@daum.net* OR *@hanmail.net* OR *@nate.com* OR *@kakao.com* OR *@yandex.ru* OR *@yandex.com* OR *@protonmail.com* OR *@proton.me* OR *@mail.ru* OR *@gmx.com* OR *@tutanota.com* OR *@outlook.kr*))
ucs.rationale: Auto-forwarding-rule abuse is a well-known generic technique, but Kimsuky's variant is distinctive: (1) it targets users in NK-policy / journalism / defector-support roles; (2) the forwarding destination is consistently Korean free-webmail (Naver, Daum, Hanmail, Nate) or privacy-mail (ProtonMail, Yandex, Mail.ru) rather than gmail.com; (3) it follows a credential-phishing AiTM login.
